title: Great Flamenco show - highly recommend
text: This was a great Flamenco show. The dancers, singer and guitarist were amazing and all full of passion, power and emotion. We highly recommend this show. The theatre also has a bar that you can buy drinks at.
author: Gail_W

title: A wonderfully passionate authentic show
text:
A wonderful passionate flamenco show in a great setting. Both the musicians and dancers were first class and mesmerising, holding our attention throughout the performance.
The venue is perfect and i am sure has great visibility wherever you are seated, but as we like to see the dancers feet clearly I contacted the theatre in advance to ask for seating close to the stage. For a nominal sum of an extra €5 each they could offer us front row seating. This was money well spent if you like to be “up close and personal” We felt the show was very authentic (we have been to several flamenco shows in Eu
author: 461geraldinel

title: Unmissable flamenco show
text: The show lasts 1h in which you are so attentive to everything that it goes by super fast. Each of the musicians and dancers transmits their strength and energy, each better than the last. For me, the fact that it is a theater and there is no obligation to buy a drink swayed my choice. Also because it was recommended to me and they were right.
author: Nuria_S

title: Awesome show
text: This was our favorite flamenco show while visiting Spain, so much talent!!
author: mlhughes319

title: Great experience
text: We enjoyed the overall experience.  The show lasted about 60 minutes.  We were in a small theatre size room. The dancers, singer, and guitar player were very good.  There is tremendous energy, passion, and technical skill involved.  We would highly recommend.
author: Mark_H

title: Great Flamenco
text: This is a great one hour performance with a quartet performing for an hour . The dancing is impressive and with feeling , which made the difference . The lady dancer is especially impressive . A must do event

title: Super show!
text: Super show! Great music and dancing! Highly recommended! Would do it again!

title: Quality show
text: It is a highly recommended show for anyone who wants to get to know flamenco. The venue is a small, very comfortable theater where you can have a drink.
